messages.subject: Open source Shiny-Server
parts:
Hello,

My Name is Gil and i actually build shiny app that i have deployed on open source shiny server.

When my users try to connect on it, they get the app stop and in chrome log they get that error:

Websocket connection closed before connection established

Someone know why?

Second how many shiny app can i deploy on that kind of server.

Thank you

messages.subject: Re: Open source Shiny-Server
parts: I would check and see if you have any errors in the logs on the server side.  When you see a wasClean:false, it usually means that your application threw an error of some kind (in my cases)

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Open source Shiny-Server
parts:
You might try adding the directive "disable_websockets;" to your /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf file, and restarting Shiny Server. We're supposed to gracefully degrade if the websocket connection is blocked, but that maybe isn't working in this case.

If you do try this and it helps, please let us know!
